openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage

      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0

          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer

            minimum: 1

                type: string

          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1

              schema:

          description: Not modified.

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId

          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1

        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.

          application/json:
            schema:

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:

          schema:

            format: int32

            ETag:

            application/json:
              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        404:
          description: Owner  not found.

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:

## What I changed

The registration date now falls on a business day for the **effective** date — whether supplied in the request or defaulted to the server date — and every value derived from it uses the adjusted date.

**New `RegistrationDate` helper** (`.../function/owner/RegistrationDate.java`) — one place that resolves the effective date: supplied date if present, else `LocalDate.now()`, then rolls a Saturday/Sunday forward to the following Monday.

**`ApplyRegistrationDate`** — previously only defaulted a *null* date to today. Now it always sets `owner.setRegistrationDate(RegistrationDate.effective(owner.getRegistrationDate()))`. Because it mutates the built owner in place before `AssignCustomerCode` and the response mapping, the membership number's year segment (`getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100`) automatically uses the adjusted date. This is the behaviour change: a supplied weekend date is now rolled forward too.

**`RequireDailyCapacity`** — previously counted owners against `LocalDate.now()`. It now reads the request DTO (`@Val OwnerFieldsDto`), computes the same effective business-day date, and counts existing owners carrying that adjusted date — so the daily create-limit caps per adjusted business day, consistent with what gets stored.

### Design notes
- Both the capacity check and the date assignment go through the single `RegistrationDate.effective(...)` helper, so the counted day and the stored day always agree.
- I implemented weekend-only rolling (Sat/Sun → Monday), exactly as the spec states. The test base has a `toBusinessDay` helper that also skips pinned holidays, but the task specification and the active assertion (`coreDefaultDateIsBusinessDay`, which only checks the day is never Sat/Sun) scope this change to weekends; I kept it to that.

## What I changed

The registration date now falls on a business day for the **effective** date — whether supplied in the request or defaulted to the server date — and every value derived from it uses the adjusted date.

**New `RegistrationDate` helper** (`.../function/owner/RegistrationDate.java`) — one place that resolves the effective date: supplied date if present, else `LocalDate.now()`, then rolls a Saturday/Sunday forward to the following Monday.

**`ApplyRegistrationDate`** — previously only defaulted a *null* date to today. Now it always sets `owner.setRegistrationDate(RegistrationDate.effective(owner.getRegistrationDate()))`. Because it mutates the built owner in place before `AssignCustomerCode` and the response mapping, the membership number's year segment (`getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100`) automatically uses the adjusted date. This is the behaviour change: a supplied weekend date is now rolled forward too.

**`RequireDailyCapacity`** — previously counted owners against `LocalDate.now()`. It now reads the request DTO (`@Val OwnerFieldsDto`), computes the same effective business-day date, and counts existing owners carrying that adjusted date — so the daily create-limit caps per adjusted business day, consistent with what gets stored.

### Design notes
- Both the capacity check and the date assignment go through the single `RegistrationDate.effective(...)` helper, so the counted day and the stored day always agree.
- I implemented weekend-only rolling (Sat/Sun → Monday), exactly as the spec states. The test base has a `toBusinessDay` helper that also skips pinned holidays, but the task specification and the active assertion (`coreDefaultDateIsBusinessDay`, which only checks the day is never Sat/Sun) scope this change to weekends; I kept it to that.
